title: A stabilizer preserving etale morphism is an open immersion
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an etale stabilizer preserving morphism with unramified automorphism group is an open immersion (author lemma at source lines 10159-10170, label lemma-etale-iso). The proof (source lines 10172-10182) derives universal injectivity from the condition on the diagonal, representability from stabilizer preservation, and concludes by the scheme-free criterion that etale universally injective morphisms are open immersions (proof lines 10172-10181). The derivation of representability is the substance. H3.
